title: viola pratensis
intro: Viola pratensis, commonly known as wild pansy or meadow pansy, is a perennial flowering plant in the violet family (Violaceae). This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative effects, as well as its potential to help lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Viola pratensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its calming effects and ability to soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, such as violine and viola violacein, as well as phenolic acids and saponins.
